reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 1 expressly states nothing creates an exclusive arrangement and that the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties — i.e., no non-compete, field-of-use or territory restriction binds Customer.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was rendered (redline text is identical to the original) and no counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct handling for a clause that benefits our party.

The deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes, corroborating the preferred-position classification; the only 'shall not' covenants noted relate to creative/content standards, which are outside the NONCOMPETE rule's scope.
